# owner: platform
"""Find the stretches of opening hours nobody covers."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from hourglass.merging import merge_spans
from hourglass.models import Span
from hourglass.parsing import format_span

Spans = Iterable[Span]

class OutsideHoursError(ValueError):
    """A worked span sticks out of the opening hours."""

def check_hours(worked: Spans, opening: Span):
    for span in worked:
        if span.start < opening.start:
            raise OutsideHoursError(format_span(span))
        if span.end > opening.end:
            raise OutsideHoursError(format_span(span))

def uncovered(worked: Spans, opening: Span) -> List[Span]:
    merged = merge_spans(worked)
    lefts = [opening.start] + [item.end for item in merged]
    rights = [item.start for item in merged]
    rights.append(opening.end)
    pairs = zip(lefts, rights)
    keep = [pair for pair in pairs if pair[0] < pair[1]]
    return [Span(*pair) for pair in keep]

def gap_label(gap: Span) -> str:
    text = format_span(gap)
    return f"gap {text} ({gap.minutes} min)"

def find_gaps(worked: Spans, opening: Span) -> List[str]:
    """One label per uncovered stretch of opening hours."""
    worked = list(worked)
    check_hours(worked, opening)
    gaps = uncovered(worked, opening)
    return [gap_label(gap) for gap in gaps]
after.tests/test_gaps.py:
# owner: platform
import unittest

from hourglass.gaps import OutsideHoursError, find_gaps
from hourglass.models import Span

OPEN = Span(8 * 60, 18 * 60)

class FindGapsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_gap_in_the_middle(self):
        worked = [Span(480, 720), Span(780, 1080)]
        labels = find_gaps(worked, OPEN)
        want = ["gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)"]
        self.assertEqual(labels, want)

    def test_no_workers_is_one_big_gap(self):
        labels = find_gaps([], OPEN)
        want = ["gap 08:00-18:00 (600 min)"]
        self.assertEqual(labels, want)

    def test_full_coverage_has_no_gaps(self):
        worked = [Span(480, 800), Span(800, 1080)]
        self.assertEqual(find_gaps(worked, OPEN), [])

    def test_edges_and_overlaps(self):
        worked = [Span(600, 700), Span(650, 750)]
        expected = [
            "gap 08:00-10:00 (120 min)",
            "gap 12:30-18:00 (330 min)"
        ]
        self.assertEqual(find_gaps(worked, OPEN), expected)

    def test_unsorted_input(self):
        worked = [Span(900, 1080), Span(480, 600)]
        labels = find_gaps(worked, OPEN)
        want = ["gap 10:00-15:00 (300 min)"]
        self.assertEqual(labels, want)

    def test_span_before_opening_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(OutsideHoursError):
            find_gaps([Span(420, 600)], OPEN)

    def test_span_after_closing_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(OutsideHoursError):
            find_gaps([Span(900, 1100)], OPEN)

    def test_error_is_a_value_error(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            find_gaps([Span(0, 60)], OPEN)
